anya_eval: flagging a reproducible ZWJ/ZWSP boundary collapse during zephyr-v1 int8 canary. zh+ar mixed strings lose spacing around invisible joiners and punctuation. zh->en BLEU -1.8, ar->en -2.0 vs fp16 on loc-blend-1k. sample below.

hiro_onboard: which tokenizer + quant config? can you paste example?

anya_eval: run id 2026-06-10-zwj-shadow. model: zephyr-v1, quant=int8 per-channel symmetric, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-05-28. eval: loc-blend-1k. sample:
```
input: "[\u0628\u0627\u0632\u06cc]\u6e2c\u8a66\u200d"  // Arabic word in brackets + CJK + ZWJ
fp16 output: "[Bazi] test"
int8 output: "[Bazi]test"
// fused space after bracket when ZWJ adjacent -> detok boundary collapse
```

marcus_research: interesting. tokenizer roundtrip on inputs ok? sounds like generation-side spacing shift (logit delta) not token-id remap.

anya_eval: tokenizer.roundtrip=ok, token ids identical. reproduced on GPU and local CPU. suspect numeric drift in KV/accum path for invisible joiner adjacency.

hiro_onboard: quick check: try env RT_KV_FP16=true RT_ACCUM_FP16=true (force fp16 for kv/accum) and re-run the failing sample.

anya_eval: ran with both flags. BLEU recovered to -0.2 and sample detok matches fp16. p50 latency +10ms. attaching kv/logit dumps to ticket ZWJ-ZWSP-INT8-21 (https://redwood.internal/issue/ZWJ-INT8-21).

marcus_research: good signal. follow-ups: 1) try softer per-channel quant clipping (reduce clip multiplier) 2) run int8 with `--soft-split-zwj` (experimental pretokenizer that inserts zero-width space between ambiguous grapheme runs) to see if detok stabilizes. if soft-split helps, Optimize can recommend a temporary mitigation.

ops-liam: for Dedicated/on-prem customers we should add a temporary Optimize rule: for datasets tagged with mixed-orient or containing invisible-joiners, recommend `kv_fp16=true` and `preserve_invisible_joins=true`. I'll draft the change and add an opt-out.

ci-bot: CI job started for ZWJ-INT8-21 on eng-ml/zephyr-v1-int8 (#4210). logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4210

anya_eval: added a small fuzz harness that injects ZWJ/ZWSP adjacent to brackets and annotated text. PR open with samples + reproducer. monitoring CI. :white_check_mark:
